subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the maintainer-owned umbrella for the placeholder plus no-reply terminal contract, or should the remaining work be split across the narrower open placeholder and incomplete-turn issues?
rationale: Current main has a partial provider-side fix, but the remaining warning and fallback changes affect retry safety, side-effect handling, and user-visible channel warnings; automation should not choose that contract alone.

options.title: Keep umbrella and define contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide and document the shared terminal tool-error behavior across placeholder, warning, and incomplete-turn paths.

options.title: Split into narrower canonicals
options.body: Move placeholder-only work to the broader tool-result placeholder issue and move payloads=0 fallback policy to the incomplete-turn issue, then close this only after cross-links preserve the evidence.

options.title: Close after live fixed-release proof
options.body: Close this later only if a current release or beta live reproduction shows both the placeholder and no-reply symptoms are resolved across affected channels.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and define contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide and document the shared terminal tool-error behavior across placeholder, warning, and incomplete-turn paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged terminal-classifier and incomplete-turn work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the policy choice.
